description: Non material amendment to: *Front porch area enclosed*Roof of front porch to be constructed as a single slope, without a hipped side elevation*Roof to ground floor side extension to be constructed as a pitched roof, rather than flat.of Householder application reference 22/2448 dated 22/11/2022 for Proposed demolition of detached garage and store rooms, erection of two-storey side extension, single storey rear extension, hip to gable end roof extension, rear dormer window with Juliet balcony, two front, two side and one rear rooflight, removal of chimney stack, removal of existing porch, new front porch canopy, rear garden outbuilding, removal of front boundary hedge, new front boundary wall, hardstanding, soft landscaping and refuse and cycle storage to dwellinghouse.
